content.scenario: A consumer, Rohan, files a complaint against a company, XYZ Ltd., for defective goods. The District Commission refers the matter to mediation under sub-section (3) of section 79. The mediator, appointed by the Commission, conducts the mediation and prepares a quarterly report to be submitted to the District Commission.
content.outcome: The mediation is conducted under the provisions of sub-section (3) of section 79, and the mediator submits a quarterly report to the District Commission as required. The consumer, Rohan, and the company, XYZ Ltd., reach a settlement, and the complaint is disposed of.
